description: Multiple Axes Chart lets you display different types of data in different ways in the same chart. It is ideal to use this kind of chart when: There are mixed data types (for example, price or volume). There is a need to show some kind of relationship or trend between the data types. The numbers in the data vary widely across data types. Any outliers need to be identified. Using PBIVizEdit's Multiple Axes Chart visual you can create variations of series types.
